about: Joyride's local Firstmate patches, applied in order with `git am` on top of the upstream pin by `./bin/joyride vendor firstmate`. They are never pushed upstream, so the pin stays at the upstream commit and vendor/firstmate counts as pinned only when every commit after the pin matches one of these patches (by `git patch-id --stable`, because re-applying a patch gives it a new SHA). `pin` must match FIRSTMATE_PIN in src/modules/firstmate/seed.ts. Regenerate a patch with `git -C vendor/firstmate format-patch -1 <sha> --zero-commit --no-signature`.

patches.why: bin/fm-timeout-lib.sh reads a bare $BASHPID under set -u, which aborts every caller on stock macOS Bash 3.2
